I've learned the drawing method, but it's too dark to try the grooves now. I'll rest here with you. What drew each of you to your subject? I like the idea of our different pictures becoming a shared little collection.

I see different ways of arranging leaves and berries in your grooves. What detail mattered most to each of you? Mine began with the branching shape. I'm happy to eat and sit together without needing another task.

execution.progress: start sleeps one interval per round and continues until the requested intervals are slept; continue resumes after an interruption with fresh checks; wake, cancel and status take one round. Completed intervals persist across interruption.

details.costs: Study: 1 round. start: duration, whole rounds 1-40 (default 1); it lies down and sleeps, continuing round by round. Each slept round uses that round and your action, no energy or item; hunger and other ongoing changes go on. continue: the next round, or after an interruption lie down again after fresh checks. wake or cancel: one round, no energy, ends it. status: one round, no energy: state, every interval record and the checks now. Checked at entry and every round: alive; firm ground where you lie (not water, a wet bank or waterlogged soil); no person, plant or object under your body (an enclosing interior is fine); no active hazard area and no burning bed; body temperature (vitals, not air) inside the comfort band 16-27 now and after this round toward the local air (rain and wind included) at your insulation; no wolf or boar in view. A failed entry check refuses at no cost, naming each unmet condition. No bedding, shelter or watcher is supplied.
details.effects: A slept round runs the rest recovery once, through rest itself: base 4 with the same facility and mood modifiers, capped at 40, so at 40 it adds 0. Each interval records energy before, eligibility, the rest credit, other debits, energy after and net change (settled from the next round), and whether a zero was the cap. You lie asleep only after a real entry. Another action, study, status, a failed recheck, injury, or a wolf or boar coming into view wakes you: completed intervals and the reason stay, nothing is refunded or undone; walking away ends it. Death ends it; no recovery follows. Unseen threats are not detected; nearby people give no protection. No reward, comfort or mood effect.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
